subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding that prices can differ for similar items, and comparing prices before spending
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares real or illustrative prices for the same type of item from two different sources
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the better-value option between two similar items with different prices
exercise.abstract: Student explains why comparing prices before buying can help someone spend wisely

misconception_flags: assumes a higher price always means better quality without considering value

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
